title: The exposed transfer

branches.condition: Lantern delivers civilian relief without passage protection
branches.consequence: Lantern's navigation team is lost. Grey Petrel assigned Protect the Navigators can save the team, spending its contracted service.

branches.condition: Lantern delivers civilian relief with passage protection
branches.consequence: The navigation team survives this threat. Grey Petrel is not called on for rescue.

branches.condition: Lantern does not deliver civilian relief
branches.consequence: This threat does not take the navigation team. Other operations and risks still apply.

guidance: You can seek protection, change which vessel carries relief, repair instead, or arrange navigator rescue while those choices remain open.
